svg.title: From prompt engineering to context engineering — a four-year arc
svg.desc: A horizontal timeline from 2022 to 2026, drawn by hand, with three era bands above it: prompt engineering, a transition marked by agents and RAG, and context engineering. Five events sit on the axis. In November 2022 ChatGPT lands and the work is one box and one prompt. Through 2023 the focus is chain-of-thought, ReAct, and the first agents. In 2024 RAG, tool use, and two-hundred-thousand-token windows arrive. Between June and September 2025 Karpathy renames the practice and Anthropic and IBM publish on it. Through 2025 and 2026 it consolidates around MCP, sub-agents, memory, and evaluation. A caption notes that the practice did not change overnight; the name caught up to it.
svg.text: Three eras, one direction: the surface the engineer works on grows from a message to a window.
The practice did not change overnight. The name caught up to it.
By 2025 most "prompt engineering" was already context engineering: tools, memory, retrieved
data, and history assembled around a small user instruction.
